Robotic Bronchoscopy Procedure Report
Procedure date: 2026-07-15

**Indication:** The patient is a former smoker (10 pack-years). Indication: tissue diagnosis of a peripheral lung lesion and mediastinal staging.

**Anesthesia:** Moderate sedation was used with a natural airway.

**Procedures:** Robotic-assisted bronchoscopy was performed as planned and completed. Linear EBUS-TBNA was performed as planned and completed.

## Robotic navigation and sampling
The Monarch robotic platform was used for navigation. Target 1 was a 18 mm solid lesion in the anterior basal segment (RB8) of the right lower lobe. A bronchus sign was present. It was not FDG-avid on PET. Target 1 was the prespecified biopsy target. The robotic catheter was navigated to target 1, and the target was reached and sampled. Radial EBUS showed a concentric view, confirming tool-in-lesion. Transbronchial needle aspiration was performed with a 22-gauge needle. Transbronchial forceps biopsies were obtained (seven passes). ROSE of target 1 showed atypical cells; the sample was adequate. Specimen A: needle aspirates from target 1 (cytology). Specimen B: forceps biopsies from target 1 (histology).

## Linear EBUS
Linear EBUS was performed for initial mediastinal staging using a systematic sampling strategy. The systematic nodal examination was complete. Station 4R was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 4R measured 22 mm in short axis. Station 4R: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 25-gauge needle, five passes. ROSE of station 4R: malignant cells, adequate. Station 7 was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 7: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 25-gauge needle, 5 passes. ROSE of station 7: blood only, inadequate. Specimen C: station 7 aspirates (cytology). Station 10R was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 10R measured 20 mm in short axis. Station 10R: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 21-gauge needle, four passes. ROSE of station 10R: non-necrotizing granulomas, adequate. Station 11L was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 11L: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 22-gauge needle, two passes. Specimen D: station 11L aspirates (cytology).

**Complications:** No immediate complications.

**Disposition:** Procedure duration: 85 minutes.

**Indication:** The patient is an 88-year-old male. Indication: tissue diagnosis of a peripheral lung lesion and mediastinal staging.

**Anesthesia:** General anesthesia via an 8.5 mm endotracheal tube.

**Procedures:** Robotic-assisted bronchoscopy was performed as planned and completed. Linear EBUS-TBNA was performed as planned and completed.

## Robotic navigation and sampling
The Ion robotic platform was used for navigation. Target 1 was a 11 mm ground-glass lesion in the superior segment (LB6) of the left lower lobe. There was no bronchus sign. It was FDG-avid (SUVmax 11.6). The robotic catheter was navigated to target 1, and the target was reached and sampled. Radial EBUS showed an eccentric view. Mobile cone-beam CT confirmed the biopsy needle within the lesion before sampling (tool-in-lesion). Transbronchial needle aspiration was performed with a 22-gauge needle (4 passes). Transbronchial forceps biopsies were obtained (four passes). Transbronchial cryobiopsy was performed with a 2.4 mm cryoprobe (3 passes). ROSE of target 1 showed malignant cells consistent with non-small cell carcinoma; the sample was adequate. Specimen B: cryobiopsies and forceps biopsies from target 1 (histology).

## Linear EBUS
Linear EBUS was performed for targeted nodal diagnosis using a targeted sampling strategy. Station 4R was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 4R: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 25-gauge needle, 5 passes. Specimen C: station 4R aspirates (cytology). Station 2R was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 2R measured 12 mm in short axis. Station 2R: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 22-gauge needle, five passes. Specimen D: station 2R aspirates (cytology). Station 7 was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 7: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 25-gauge needle, 3 passes. ROSE of station 7: lymphocytes, adequate for evaluation. Specimen E: station 7 aspirates (cytology).

**Complications:** No immediate complications.

**Disposition:** The patient was admitted for overnight observation.

Procedure date: 2026-07-04

pt: 72-year-old male, current smoker (40 pack-years). Indication: tissue diagnosis of a peripheral lung lesion.

General anesthesia via a 7.5 mm endotracheal tube.

Robotic-assisted bronchoscopy was attempted as planned but aborted after it started because the target could not be reached.

The Ion robotic platform was used for navigation. Target 1 was a 14 mm solid lesion in the anterior segment (LB3) of the left upper lobe. It was not FDG-avid on PET. Target 1 was not sampled because it was not reached. Navigation to target 1 was attempted, but the target could not be reached desipte repeated attempts; the target was not reached.

No immediate complications.

The patient was admitted for overnight observation.

Robotic Bronchoscopy Procedure Report
Procedure date: 2026-07-28

The patient is a 78-year-old male, current smoker (40 pack-years).

Moderate sedation was used with a natural airway.

Robotic-assisted bronchoscopy was performed as planned and completed. Linear EBUS-TBNA was performed as planned and completed.

Target 1 was a 0.9 cm lesion in the lingula. There was no bronchus sign. It was FDG-avid (SUVmax 5.8). The robotic catheter was navigated to target 1, and the target was reached and sampled. Radial EBUS showed an adjacent view. Fixed cone-beam CT confirmed the needle tip within the lesion before sampling (tool-in-lesion). Fluoroscopy was used during sampling. Transbronchial needle aspiration was performed with a 21-gauge needle. Transbronchial forceps biopsies were obtained (5 passes). Specimen A: needle aspirates from target 1 (cytology). Specimen B: forceps biopsies from target 1 (histology).

Linear EBUS was performed for initial mediastinal staging using a systematic sampling strategy. Station 7 was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 7: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 22-gauge needle, 4 passes. Station 11R was visualized on EBUS but not sampled because it measured under 5 mm with benign sonographic features. Station 11R measured 3 mm in short axis. Station 2R was visualized on EBUS but not sampled because an intervening vessel prevented a safe needle path. Station 2R measured 4 mm in short axis.

No immediate complications.

Procedure duration: 89 minutes. The patient was discharged home after recovery.
